id: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring (2001)

facts.text: Aragorn, there's a full table here and I've counted the plates twice. Mine's the one with extra mushrooms.
facts.why: Pippin never says this. His real food line, said to Strider on the road, is 'What about second breakfast?'

facts.text: Merry's discovery: it comes in pints.
facts.why: In the Prancing Pony it is Pippin who says 'It comes in pints?' when Merry brings a pint to the table.
facts.fix: Pippin's discovery: it comes in pints.

vibe.verdict: The Prancing Pony and the hobbit meal gags suit the film well, but the poster sits in a dark letterbox and several notes are thin.
missing: Gandalf's 'A wizard is never late' (Bag End)
Gimli's roaring fires, malt beer and red meat off the bone
Gandalf's 'You shall not pass' on the bridge
Sam, the cooking pots and the stew (the road)
Lembas shared on the way (the Fellowship)
Bilbo's speech with butter scraped over too much bread
ideas: Swap 'Black pudding and apple bites' note for the real exchange, 'What about elevenses? Luncheon? Afternoon tea?'
Swap 'Shire seed cake' note for Bilbo's 'butter scraped over too much bread' line about feeling thin
Rename 'Prancing Pony pie' to 'Red meat off the bone' with Gimli's line in the note
Fill the tall black letterbox around the poster so the left panel looks full
iconic: Bilbo's party and Gandalf's fireworks (cue, dish, prop)
One does not simply walk into Mordor (wink)
You shall not pass on the bridge (wink)
changed: Wink: A wizard is never late replaces the birthday party wink (the cue has the party)
Wink: One does not simply walk into Mordor replaces the Council of Elrond wink
Wink: You shall not pass on the bridge
